name: Wax or Wane, All Gild the Bough
take: Both phases pay her now: +40% ATK the entire time Lunar Cycle is up, +1 Resonance Energy per second while she stands in her own domain, and Arc Beyond the Edge plus Absolute Fullness go interrupt-immune. Wax or wane, ring or bow — every state of the moon gilds. This is the node lighting her ◆ on this roster, and it's the right one: the foundation stone of the whole lunar economy.

name: Day or Night, Let This Be Eternal
take: Any teammate who reaches 10 stacks of Blessing of the Wan Light gains an ADDITIONAL 40% all-DMG Amplification — stacking on the 40% the stacks already gave. Eighty percent amplification for standing in the light and letting her shield you. The node name is a prayer and the effect is the answer: the full moon, made permanent policy.

name: I Drink Deep of Their Forgetting
take: The Moonbow suite — enhanced basics, Arc Beyond the Edge, dodge counters — gains a flat 65% DMG Amplification in Lunar Cycle, and weaving Arc between Moonbow strings no longer resets the combo cycle. Her spend-phase stops being utility-with-damage and becomes a genuine DPS rotation with a seamless weave. The moon drinks, and what she drinks becomes moonlight.

name: Rainy Season Dwell in My Eyes
take: Absolute Fullness now shields the ENTIRE team for 160% of her ATK for 30s. Follow the plumbing: she casts Fullness, the domain rises, the shield lands inside the domain, and gaining a shield in the domain mints Wan Light stacks — her burst now feeds its own amplification engine in one cast. The rainy season waters everything: armor that grows damage that grows worship.

name: A Thousand Futile Glimpses
take: A quiet 20% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus that is anything but quiet on HER sheet — the Moonbow strings, the dodge counters, Arc, Flux, Absolute Fullness, the ult itself: virtually everything she throws is Liberation-typed borrowed light. One stat line, blanket coverage of the entire moonlit arsenal. The glimpses were never futile; they were all deposits.

name: I Am the Constant in the Chaos
take: Absolute Fullness gains SIXTEEN HUNDRED percent of additional multiplier — the gentle end-of-cycle heal becomes one of the hardest-hitting single casts on the roster. And then, instead of setting, the moon refuses: she re-enters New Moon immediately with a full 100 Sentience and every Arc charge refreshed. The cycle that defined her kit stops cycling at S6. Perpetual full moon, perpetual spend-phase, and the name says the quiet part with its whole chest: the chaos is everyone else. She is what remains.
